mentions.name: IntroKeep
mentions.description: This app makes easy two-way connections at conferences, meetings, and booths using QR code and card scanning, and includes automation that auto-sends a WhatsApp Business message when someone scans your QR code. Available on iOS with an Android beta.
mentions.audience: People making connections at conferences, meetings, and booths
